Victorian road crashes resulting in casualties, 2012 to 2025

Source: R/data_vic_crashes.R
vic_crashes.Rd

One row per road crash in Victoria in which at least one person was injured or killed, from 1 January 2012 to 31 December 2025, as recorded by Victoria Police.

Usage

vic_crashes

Format

A tibble with 202,065 rows and 51 columns:

accident_no

(character) Unique crash identifier.

accident_date

(Date) Date of the crash.

year

(integer) Year of the crash.

month

(factor) Month of the crash, Jan to Dec.

day_of_week

(factor) Day of the week, Monday to Sunday.

hour

(integer) Hour of the day, 0 to 23 (17 means 5:00pm to 5:59pm).

accident_type

(character) Type of crash, for example Collision with vehicle or Struck Pedestrian.

dca_code_description

(character) Detailed crash type (Definitions for Classifying Accidents).

light_condition

(character) Light at the time of the crash, for example Day or Dark No street lights.

police_attend

(character) Whether police attended the scene (Yes or No).

road_geometry

(character) Road layout, for example T intersection or Not at intersection.

severity

(factor) Severity of the crash: Fatal accident, Serious injury accident or Other injury accident.

speed_zone

(ordered factor) Speed limit, 30 km/h to 110 km/h, then Off road and Other.

run_offroad

(character) Whether the vehicle ran off the road (Yes or No).

road_full_name

(character) Road name and type, for example Alfred Street.

lga_name

(character) Local government area (LGA), spelled as in vic_lga.

dtp_region

(character) Department of Transport and Planning region.

latitude

(numeric) Latitude of the crash.

longitude

(numeric) Longitude of the crash.

total_persons

(numeric) People involved.

inj_or_fatal

(numeric) People killed or injured.

fatality

(numeric) People killed.

seriousinjury

(numeric) People seriously injured.

otherinjury

(numeric) People with other injuries.

noninjured

(numeric) People not injured.

males

(numeric) Males involved.

females

(numeric) Females involved.

bicyclist

(numeric) Cyclists involved.

passenger

(numeric) Passengers involved.

driver

(numeric) Drivers involved.

pedestrian

(numeric) Pedestrians involved.

pillion

(numeric) Pillion passengers involved.

motorcyclist

(numeric) Motorcyclists involved.

unknown

(numeric) Road users of unknown type involved.

ped_cyclist_5_12

(numeric) Pedestrians and cyclists aged 5 to 12 involved.

ped_cyclist_13_18

(numeric) Pedestrians and cyclists aged 13 to 18 involved.

old_ped_65_and_over

(numeric) Pedestrians aged 65 and over involved.

old_driver_75_and_over

(numeric) Drivers aged 75 and over involved.

young_driver_18_25

(numeric) Drivers aged 18 to 25 involved.

no_of_vehicles

(numeric) Vehicles involved, including bicycles.

heavyvehicle

(numeric) Heavy vehicles involved.

passengervehicle

(numeric) Passenger vehicles involved.

motorcycle

(numeric) Motorcycles involved.

pt_vehicle

(numeric) Public transport vehicles involved (tram, bus or train).

deg_urban_name

(character) How urban the location is, for example MELB_URBAN or RURAL_VICTORIA.

rma

(character) Road classification, for example Freeway or Local Road.

divided

(character) Whether the road is divided (Divided or Undivided).

stat_div_name

(character) Statistical division (Metro or Country).

involves_pedestrian

(logical) At least one pedestrian involved.

involves_cyclist

(logical) At least one cyclist involved.

involves_motorcyclist

(logical) At least one motorcyclist or pillion passenger involved.

Source

Victorian Government (Department of Transport and Planning), Victorian road crash data, https://discover.data.vic.gov.au/dataset/victoria-road-crash-data, licensed under CC BY 4.0. Data last updated 13 October 2026; retrieved 25 October 2026.

Changes made: kept casualty crashes up to 31 December 2025; cleaned column names; added year, month, hour, road_full_name and the involves_* columns; converted categories to factors; set Unk. and Not known to NA; matched LGA names to vic_lga; removed ACCIDENT_TIME, VICGRID_X, VICGRID_Y, ROAD_ROUTE_1, ROAD_NAME, ROAD_TYPE, DCA_CODE and SRNS.
